name: pdf_tools
description: Read, extract text from, and search within PDF documents.
_note: Requires PyPDF2 or pymupdf: pip install PyPDF2

manual.overview: Use when you need to read or search PDF documents—contracts, reports, books. Supports text extraction, pagecount, and search within PDFs.

examples.description: Extract text from first 5 pages of a report
Find all occurrences of 'configuration' in the manual

tips: Scanned PDFs contain images—text extraction may return empty; use OCR tools separately
Use 'pages' to limit extraction on large PDFs and avoid memory issues
Search is case-sensitive; normalize query if needed
edge_cases: Encrypted or password-protected PDFs will fail without the password
Some PDFs have non-standard encoding; extracted text may have garbled characters

executor.command: python -c "import PyPDF2, json, sys; reader=PyPDF2.PdfReader('{{args.path}}'); pages=range(len(reader.pages)); text='\n'.join(reader.pages[i].extract_text() or '' for i in pages); print(text[:10000])"
